result.title: PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors
result.summary: Conformal prediction sets are guaranteed to be marginally valid over the attribute space, but local coverage can diverge from the user-defined target $1-α$. Constructing conditionally valid prediction sets with finite calibration data is impossible for a general data-generating distribution. We derive PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the input-conditional coverage of any conformal predictor, without assumptions on the data distribution. They are based on the Markov and Cantelli inequalities and adapt to both calibration-marginal and calibration-conditional setups. A tighter, model-dependent Cantelli bound depends on the variance of the conditional coverage and is estimable from data using a fully non-asymptotic Hoeffding argument. The results suggest conditional-coverage variance as a scalable and theoretically motivated empirical measure of conditional validity.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在不对数据分布作假设的前提下，用 Markov 与 Cantelli 不等式推导任意 conformal predictor 输入条件覆盖率的 PAC 型概率下界，覆盖校准边缘与校准条件两种设定，并给出依赖条件覆盖率方差的、可非渐近估计的更紧界。
AI.relevance_reason: 条件覆盖率下界与「条件覆盖率方差」这一可估计量，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和 STOP 决策的可靠性给出有限样本校准式评价，但与原论文的推理机制无直接关联，需核查其是否适用于序列化、依赖样本的推理轨迹。
